text:
The dish looks like scrambled eggs with shredded carrot on a square plate. I used the plate as the ruler: it is roughly 22-24 cm across, a bit smaller than a dinner plate. The food covers about 12 cm by 14 cm and is fairly thick, about 2-3 cm in places.

For weight, that footprint at a few centimeters deep gives a volume of roughly 250-300 ml. Scrambled eggs are fluffy, so I took about 0.7 g/ml, which gives about 180-200 g of food.

For energy, scrambled eggs made with oil run about 180-200 kcal per 100 g. The carrot adds little. At about 190 g, that comes to roughly 330 kcal.
